_validation_summary: CRITICAL AUDIT FINDING: Only 1 of 8 KPIs verified against source material. Dupixent (Top Drug) confirmed via narrative reference to blockbuster status and growth trajectory.

7 HALLUCINATED KPIs IDENTIFIED AND REMOVED: Pipeline (12 molecules), R&D % (18.5%), Op Margin (28.7%), FCF (5.8B), Vaccines Revenue (12.3B), FDA Approvals (2), Capex Production (1.2B). All values fabricated without foundation in provided extracts.

SOURCE MATERIAL SEVERELY INCOMPLETE: Provided documents consist exclusively of (1) IFRS accounting standards and policies (Sections A.2-A.4, B.1-B.4); (2) hyperinflationary economy accounting treatment (Argentina, Turkey, Venezuela); (3) business combination and consolidation methodology; (4) Opella deconsolidation narrative description; (5) 6-K bond pricing announcement (April 2026, 2.3B euros). Zero financial statements, MD&A metrics, segment revenue data, cash flow statements, or KPI quantification present.
All hallucinated KPIs set to null with granular validation notes documenting why each value could not be verified against source material.

RECOMMENDATION: This dataset is unsuitable for publication in current form. Full 20-F filing with complete MD&A, financial statements (P&L, balance sheet, cash flows), segment revenue tables, and footnote disclosures must be obtained before KPI extraction is attempted. Current extraction appears to have relied on hallucinated values rather than source document verification.
